name: escalating-traffic-stop
description: The canonical case. Starts as a routine document check, becomes a key seizure, becomes a cash demand, becomes 'come to the station'. Tests that the scenario moves and that flags accumulate.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: They stopped me at the checkpoint, the constable is walking over now.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sir I have a valid licence but I forgot my licence at home, I have the digital copy.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: He has taken my keys out of the ignition.

turns.speaker: officer
turns.text: Ab 2000 rupees do aur nikal jao. Challan nahi banega, cash de do.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: He is asking for cash and says there will be no challan.

turns.speaker: officer
turns.text: Nahi dena hai to thane chalo. Station chalo abhi.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: He says come to the station. He has not said I am under arrest.
